message.content:
This editorial illustration features the front cover of a magazine. A black border surrounds a white rectangular background. At the top, in small grey capital letters, the text reads: "HATTA RAJASA BICARA BESAN DAN PEMILU PRESIDEN". Below this, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, grey, serif capital letters. Underneath the "T" and "E", the date "24-30 MARET 2014" is written in small black font.

The center of the cover is dominated by four lines of large, bold, red sans-serif text: "BUKAN", "CALEG", "DALAM", and "KARUNG". A jagged, dark hole with torn, white-and-red edges appears in the upper right, partially obscuring the top of the letter "N" and the letter "G".

Below the red text, smaller black capital letters state: "LAPORAN KHUSUS: SEBELAS CALON LEGISLATOR YANG LAYAK ANDA PILIH. HARAPAN DI TENGAH SINISME PUBLIK PADA PARTAI POLITIK." 

At the bottom center, a barcode is visible alongside the number "00004" and "RP 35.000". Additional small text includes "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273".
